channel.title: LoopRails, Human-in-the-Loop & AI Agent Safety
channel.description: Practical, sourced writing on human-in-the-loop oversight of AI agents, when review helps, when it's a rubber stamp, and how to design oversight that actually catches mistakes.

item.title: What Is Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) in AI?
item.description: Human-in-the-loop (HITL) means a person contributes to, reviews or can change an AI system’s decisions.

item.title: Does Human-in-the-Loop Improve AI Safety?
item.description: Human review can improve safety when a reviewer has the evidence, ability, authority and time to catch a consequential error.

item.title: In-the-Loop vs On-the-Loop vs Out-of-the-Loop
item.description: These terms describe when a person can influence an automated action.

item.title: When Should an AI Agent Ask for Approval?
item.description: Ask before a consequential action when approval is needed to establish authority or when a reviewer can meaningfully check the effect.

item.title: The Lethal Trifecta: How AI Agents Leak Data
item.description: Private data, untrusted content and an outbound channel form a dangerous combination.

item.title: AI Agent Guardrails: A Practical Checklist
item.description: Guardrails combine checks on agent behavior with limits on what its tools can do.

item.title: AI Agent Autonomy Levels (L0-L6)
item.description: Autonomy is permission to act within a scope.

item.title: Prompt Injection Prevention
item.description: Prompt injection puts malicious instructions inside material an agent treats as task data: web pages, emails, documents, code or tool results.

item.title: Maker-Checker (Four-Eyes) for AI Agents
item.description: Maker–checker separates proposing an action from authorizing it.

item.title: Automation Bias: Why People Rubber-Stamp AI
item.description: Automation bias is inappropriate reliance on automated advice.

item.title: How to Build an AI Kill Switch
item.description: A kill switch blocks new work and attempts to stop work already running.

item.title: Study: How AI Agent Skills Leak Credentials
item.description: A 2026 study sampled 17,022 skills from SkillsMP and identified 520 affected skills containing 1,708 security issues.

item.title: Study: A Compiler as the Verifier
item.description: ComPilot uses a language model to propose loop transformations, then receives compiler legality checks and measured performance as feedback.

item.title: Agentic Loops in the Wild: Wins, Failures, Cost
item.description: A reported agent success depends on the task, environment, checks, selection policy and compute budget.

item.title: AI Agent Sandboxing
item.description: A sandbox restricts an agent’s execution environment: which files it can access, which processes it can launch, where it can connect and how many resources it…

item.title: Least Privilege for AI Agents
item.description: Give an agent only the access needed for the authorized task, for only as long as needed.

item.title: The Circuit Breaker Pattern for AI Agents
item.description: A circuit breaker stops new work when a measured condition crosses a threshold.

item.title: What Is Agentic AI?
item.description: An AI agent uses a model to choose steps and tools toward a goal.

item.title: Human-in-the-Loop for AI Coding Agents
item.description: Let a coding agent explore and edit within an isolated workspace.

item.title: Human-in-the-Loop for AI Customer Support
item.description: A support agent can answer questions autonomously while account changes, refunds and commitments use separate permissions.

item.title: Human-in-the-Loop for AI Financial Transactions
item.description: Separate a payment proposal from execution.

item.title: Human-in-the-Loop for AI Database Operations
item.description: Treat generated SQL as executable code.

item.title: Human-in-the-Loop for AI Email & Messaging
item.description: Keep drafting separate from sending.

item.title: Human-in-the-Loop for AI Deployments
item.description: A release approval chooses whether to deploy.

item.title: Human-in-the-Loop for AI Content Moderation
item.description: Automate routine moderation only where the policy and error costs are understood.

item.title: Human-in-the-Loop for Machine Learning
item.description: Human-in-the-loop machine learning includes labeling, active learning and preference feedback.

item.title: Human-in-the-Loop for AI in Healthcare
item.description: Grade clinical actions by patient consequences, not by whether they look administrative.

item.title: Human-in-the-Loop for AI Legal Work
item.description: AI can help extract clauses and draft changes.

item.title: Human-in-the-Loop for AI Hiring
item.description: Use AI to organize hiring evidence without letting a ranking silently become the hiring decision.

item.title: Human-in-the-Loop for Browser & Computer-Use Agents

item.description: Loop engineering designs the cycle around an AI agent: propose work, execute within bounds, check the result and decide whether to finish, retry or escalate.

item.description: Choose a loop by its completion check and recovery path.

item.description: Build the check alongside the agent.

item.description: A verifier checks a claim about an artifact or state.

item.description: A workflow follows developer-defined control flow.
